data_origin: external-publisher synthetic fixtures; no customer documents

runtime.evaluation_scope: OCR-local extract(); no HTTP compatibility, history, or fraud calibration claim

limitations: Publisher-provided synthetic expected.json labels are not independent human annotations.
This is a small supplemental challenge set, not a representative vendor holdout or production accuracy estimate.
The service schema does not represent discounts, freight, duty, barcodes, pack conversions, or free quantities; those concepts are reported as unsupported, not scored as extraction failures.
This run uses the English Paddle recognition model. Arabic and bilingual Arabic layouts remain outside validated support and should be expected to abstain or require review.
The multi-page fixture's PNG contains only page one and was excluded from whole-invoice scoring; its complete PDF was evaluated.

Direct extraction-stack evaluation bypasses HTTP required-field rejection, observation history, downstream policy/wallet behavior, and Qwen; it does not establish transaction safety or fraud precision/recall.
